[b]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/b] is a reimagining of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]PPJA Artisan Valley[/url]'s foundations, fully rewritten for 1.6 with a refreshing spin and lovingly updated artwork from Mizu and 6480!

What you can find in this mod:

[list]
[*]10 new artisan machines, for a variety of playstyles!
[*]80+ new artisan goods from vanilla and custom machines
[*]4 new special orders and charming events
[*]Vanilla-style balance designed with both Automate and non-Automate users in mind
[/list]
Artisan Machines has some unique items if playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url], but it is [b]not required![/b] You can use Artisan Machines with an entirely vanilla crop roster, or use it with other amazing crop mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22728]Wildflour's Forager[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22490]Bonster's Crops[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16999]Quaint Living 2[/url], and more!

Check out the images or wiki to see what's included![center]
[b][img]https://imgur.com/Z3PY4Wr.png[/img][/b][/center][b][b][b]
Q: Can I install or uninstall this mod in an existing game?
A: Absolutely.[/b] [/b][/b]This mod can be safely added or removed to any save file. You will not miss out on any content by adding it to an existing save. If you decide to remove the mod, any leftover items can be safely thrown away.[b][b]
[/b][/b]
[b]Q: Is Cornucopia compatible with [insert mod here]?
A: [/b]Cornucopia is technically compatible with [i]any[/i] other mod, even those that add the same items. However, you may have different versions of the same crops if you have multiple artisan goods mods installed.
[b]
Q: Do I need to download all the Cornucopia mods?
A:[/b] Not at all! In fact, [i]any[/i] of the Cornucopia mods can be played with entirely by themselves. Please feel free to play the way you like best.

[b]Q: Can I help out?
A: [/b][b]Yes. [/b]We always especially need help from translators and wiki contributors! But, you can also give us feedback to improve our mods. Please leave a comment or [url=https://discord.gg/qEMWVcNPxe][b]join our Discord[/b][/url][b]. [/b]For questions and concerns over DMs, please contact 6480.
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vsn2Afz.png[/img]﻿[/center][b]
[/b][list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿[/b] - Full lookup compatibility (Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/zombifier/about-me?gameId=1303]zombifier[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Pathoschild[/url]﻿ for updating LA!). Consider using Lookup Anything if you find yourself confused by certain machine items.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿ - Full compat! If you have issues with mill items, try placing them manually in the mill.
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672]Junimatic[/url]﻿[/b] - Full compat!
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22730]Wildflour Atelier Goods[/url]﻿ [/b]- No known clashes, but you may have some duplicate items based on which WAG mods you have installed. They won't cause any issues! Just be sure to read our separate guides to know how to use them.
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url]﻿[/b] - You can smoke Animal Husbandry meat items!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23146]More Sensible Juices[/url]﻿ - By default, you can use both mods fine with no issues. However if you would prefer not to have two juicer machines, you can turn off the setting [b]Enable Juicer[/b] in the config menu.
[/list]
In general, [b]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/b] should be able to work with custom items of any generic category, such as [b]fruits, vegetables,[/b] and [b]flowers.[/b] There are additional specific categories such as herbs, cheese, or plant milks that a mod author may want to tag. If you are a mod author, please feel free to reach out to 6480 or join our Discord server for assistance!
[center]
[img]https://imgur.com/LRY9aFQ.png[/img][/center][b]
